mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Cart (cart_id, member_id, book_id, quantity) VALUES (cart_seq.NEXTVAL, #{member_id}, #{book_id}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.member_id, c.book_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, b.title, b.price, b.cover_image, p.name AS publisher_name FROM Cart c JOIN Book b ON c.book_id = b.book_id LEFT JOIN Publisher p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id WHERE c.member_id = #{member_id} ORDER BY c.cart_id DESC
SELECT * FROM Cart WHERE member_id = #{member_id} AND book_id = #{book_id}
